header.title: Theses
header.description: What we look for on the radar and why.

actions.suggest: Suggest theses from the knowledge base

suggestions.title: Theses suggested by the knowledge base
suggestions.description: Topics from your documents. Choose one to open a thesis form.
suggestions.empty: No theses to suggest yet — upload more documents and the system will find which technologies they develop.
suggestions.aiNote: Theses are suggested from the uploaded works — they are hints, not verified conclusions. Review before creating.

list.archiveEmpty: This list is empty for now.

empty.title: Create your first thesis
empty.description: Describe what you look for on the radar and why, and which indicator will tell you the forecast has come true. The radar will find signals for the thesis, and the system will assemble hypotheses with links to sources.

card.generateHint: The system will study the knowledge-base documents and create testable hypotheses for this thesis — they will appear on the Hypotheses page.
card.directionsHint: Draft topics at the intersection of your documents: which processes and properties relate to this thesis. They open in a side panel.
card.findSignalsHint: The radar will open results for “{{query}}”, and the search will be saved to the thesis.
card.archiveHint: Remove from the working list without deleting anything

toast.directionSaved: Draft topic saved to hypothesis drafts
toast.directionSavedHint: You can find it on the Hypotheses page under the Drafts tab.
toast.directionSaveError: Failed to save the draft topic

dialog.title: New thesis
dialog.name: Title
dialog.namePlaceholder: e.g. LLM agent security ready for an enterprise pilot
dialog.metric: Indicator (how you will know the forecast came true)
dialog.metricPlaceholder: e.g. technologies at pilot stage or later
dialog.directionNote: The direction of change is inferred automatically. You can leave the exact target value empty if it is not known yet.

sheet.title: Draft topics from the knowledge graph
sheet.intro: The system links knowledge across documents: which process affects which property and how that relates to the thesis. Save a topic you like — it becomes a hypothesis draft on the Hypotheses page.
sheet.loading: Searching the knowledge graph for connections…
sheet.emptyDescription: The knowledge graph has too few connections for this thesis yet. Upload more documents or generate hypotheses — the system will find topics at their intersection.
sheet.shownOf: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. The limit can be changed in system settings.
sheet.aiNote: Draft topics are suggested from connections in the knowledge base — they are hints, not confirmed conclusions.

directionCard.savedHint: it will appear under the Drafts tab on the Hypotheses page

delete.title: Delete thesis “{{title}}”?
delete.body: Hypotheses and draft topics created for this thesis will remain — they simply become unlinked. This cannot be undone.

wizard.title: New thesis and hypotheses
wizard.description: Describe in your own words what you look for on the radar and why. You can attach materials — market reviews, reports, investment committee memos.
wizard.newGoal: New thesis — I'll describe it in text
wizard.prompt: What we look for and why
wizard.promptPlaceholder: E.g.: technologies that will cut the cost of on-device AI inference several-fold within 2–3 years. We are interested in solutions with first pilots at device makers; by the end of 2027 we want two technologies at pilot stage or later.
wizard.promptExistingPlaceholder: E.g.: horizon — until the end of 2027, open-license solutions only.
wizard.promptHint: The system extracts the thesis title, indicator and constraints from your text.
wizard.addFiles: Add files or drop them here
wizard.dropHere: Drop the files to attach them to the thesis
wizard.filesNote: Attached files become this thesis's input data: facts come from them, justification comes from the knowledge base.
wizard.generatingToast: Hypothesis generation for the thesis has started
wizard.editDescription: Your wording and attached materials. Change the text or files — and regenerate hypotheses if needed.
wizard.editHint: If you change the text, the system re-extracts the title, indicator and constraints.

page.betsEmpty: No forecasts yet: create a hypothesis from a signal card in the radar results.

signals.title: Signals for the thesis
signals.description: The saved results for the thesis query and searches opened from the thesis, with their best technologies.
signals.empty: No searches from this thesis yet. Press “Find signals for the thesis” — the radar will open results, and the search will appear here.
signals.pending: The results are not saved yet: the search is running or was interrupted. Open them to see the progress.
signals.noCandidates: The saved results contain no technologies.
